messages.author: cca670ab8f456470
messages.subject: YARN integration
parts:
Hello, guys! I'd like to ask some questions about the development of RHipe.

I'd like to know if you plan to release a stable version of Rhipe which is also fully integrated with YARN.
At the moment, I have only read somewhere that there's a build of Rhipe which works with YARN but it's not fully tested.
I am not very acknowledged with this subject yet  and I'm very interested to know more about it.

Thanks for providing such a wonderful tool.

Looking forward to your reply,

BigData Group.

messages.author: 2f3428d3166aad1c
messages.subject: Re: YARN integration
parts: We have been using YARN successfully, although not extensively in production.  If you would like to try it out, you can either get the following: Rhipe_0.75.0_cdh5mr2.tar.gz built against cdh5, or clone our dev branch and build it: https://github.com/tesseradata/RHIPE/tree/dev.  We are actively working on this branch and plan to exclusively support YARN from this version on.  Let us know if you have any questions.
